spans.s: शुल्क् vt. 10U (pres. शुल्कयति-ते) 1. To tell, to narrate; 2. to create; 3. to leave, to forsake, to abandon.

शुल्क m.n. 1. A toll, a tax, a duty, (especially that levied at ferries, roads &c.), दंडशुल्कावशेषं च न पुत्रो दातुर्महति M.viii.159; 2. money advanced to ratify a bargain; 3. gain, profit; 4. money given to the parents of a bride, शुल्कं हि गृह्णन् कुरुते छन्नं दुहितृविक्रयम् M.ix.98, पीडितो दुहितृशुल्कसंस्थया R.xi.38, Bt.v.36; 5. a present made by a bridegroom to his bride.
शुल्क-द m. an affianced suitor.
शुल्क-शाला f. a custom-house.
शुल्क-स्थान n. a custom-house.
शुल्ल n. 1. Copper; 2. a rope, a string.

शूल m.n. 1. Any acute pain; 2. colic; 3. rheumatism; 4. the trident of Śiva; 5. a pike, a spear, a lance; 6. an iron spit for roasting meat, शूलेनान्विच्छतीत्यायःशूलिकः K.Pr.x.; 7. a stake for impaling criminals, K.S.v.73; 8. death; 9. an ensign, a banner.(शूलाकृ ‘to roast on a spit.’)
शूला f. 1. A harlot, a prostitute; 2. a stake for impaling criminals.
शुल्व्(ल्ब्) vt. 10U (pres. शुल्वयति-ते) 1. To measure; 2. to give, to bestow; 3. to send away, to dismiss.
शुल्व्(ल्ब्) vt. 10U (pres. शुल्वयति-ते) 1. To measure; 2. to give, to bestow; 3. to send away, to dismiss.
शुल्व(ल्ब) n. 1. Copper; 2. a rope, a string; 3. place near water; 4. a law, an institute; 5. a sacrificial act.
शुल्वा(ल्बा) f. The same as शुल्व (2) q.v.
शुल्व(ल्ब) n. 1. Copper; 2. a rope, a string; 3. place near water; 4. a law, an institute; 5. a sacrificial act.
शुल्वा(ल्बा) f. The same as शुल्व (2) q.v.
शुल्व(ल्ब)-अरि m. sulphur.
शुल्व(ल्ब)-अरि m. sulphur.
शुल्व(ल्ब)-ज n. brass.

शुल्वा(ल्बा) f. The same as शुल्व (2) q.v.

शूल् vi. 1P (pres. शूलति) 1. To be ill; 2. to make a noise.
शूल-अग्र n. the point of a pike.
शूल-ग्रंथि f. a kind of Dūrvā grass.
शूल-घातन n. iron filings.
शूल-धन्वन्, -धर, -धारिन्, -धृक्, -पाणि, -भृत् m. an epithet of Śiva, व्यापारितः शूलभृता विधाय सिंहत्वमंकागतसत्ववृत्ति R.ii.38.

शूल-शत्रु m. the castor-oil plant.
शूल-हंत्री f. kind of barley.
शूलक m. A restive horse.
शूलाकृत n. Roasted meat.
शूलिक (I) a. (f. का) Roasted on a spit.
शूलिक (II) m. A hare.
शूलिक (III) n. Roasted meat.
शूलिक (I) a. (f. का) Roasted on a spit.
शूलिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Suffering from colic; 2. armed with a spear, दुर्जयां लवणः शूलि R.xv.5.
शूलिन् (II) m. 1. A spearman; 2. a hare; 3. an epithet of Śiva, कुर्वत्संध्याबलिपटहतां शूलिनः श्लाघनीयाम् Megh.i.34, K.S.iii.57.

शूलिन m. The Indian fig tree.
शूल्य (I) a. (f. ल्या) 1. Roasted on a spit; 2. deserving impalement.
शूल्य (II) n. Roasted meat.

सुलक्षण (I) a. Having beautiful or auspicious marks.
सुलक्षण (II) n. 1. Observing or examining carefully, ascertaining, determining; 2. a good mark or characteristic.

सुलभ a. (f. भा) 1. Easy of acquisition or attainment, feasible, attainable, न सुलभा सकलेंदुमुखी च किमपि चेदमनंगविचेष्टितम् Vikr.ii., K.S.v.69; 2. suitable, proper, fit, natural to, चरणोपभोगसुलभो लाक्षारसः केनचित् Sak.iv.
